pages.text: An Envioker's envy outlives even death itself. Let your Envioker Servant perish while you wear the Nameless Set, and it will return as a Bound Envioker—a floating caster that still summons Tormentors, calls forth fangs and flying blades, and rains illager magic upon your foes.
Of course, you can also summon a Bound Envioker directly through a ritual.
Bound Enviokers fight for you with powerful spells.
